--- revoke_on_all_sequences_in_default_schema.sql
REVOKE SELECT, UPDATE ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA DEFAULT FROM ROLE role1

--- AST
&ast.Revoke{
  Privilege: &ast.PrivilegeOnAllSequencesInSchema{
    Privileges: []ast.TablePrivilege{
      &ast.SelectPrivilege{
        Select: 7,
        Rparen: -1,
      },
      &ast.UpdatePrivilege{
        Update: 15,
        Rparen: -1,
      },
    },
    Default: 49,
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 67,
      NameEnd: 72,
      Name:    "role1",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
REVOKE SELECT, UPDATE ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA DEFAULT FROM ROLE role1
